gloss: generously; warmly; cordially; with great care

definitions.gloss: generously; warmly; cordially; with great care and hospitality
definitions.explanation: Doing something with exceptional care, warmth, or generosity that goes above and beyond ordinary treatment, used in contexts of hospitality, caregiving, and support.

examples.japanese: {手厚|てあつ}く⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧。
⟦{怪我人|けがにん}→怪我人：23513_keganin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手厚|てあつ}く⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The injured person was cared for attentively.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{福利厚生|ふくりこうせい}→福利厚生：04882_fukurikousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手厚|てあつ}く⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This company generously provides employee welfare benefits.

notes:
The adverbial form of ⟦{手厚|てあつ}い→手厚い：12802_teatsui⟧ (generous, cordial, thorough). Describes doing something with exceptional care, warmth, or generosity — going above and beyond ordinary treatment. Used in contexts of hospitality, caregiving, support, and service.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手厚|てあつ}く⟦もてなす→もてなす：10635_motenasu⟧: to treat with warm hospitality
- {手厚|てあつ}く⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to nurse attentively
- {手厚|てあつ}く⟦{保護|ほご}する→保護する：25374_hogosuru⟧: to protect generously
- {手厚|てあつ}く⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧: to support generously
- {手厚|てあつ}く⟦{葬|ほうむ}る→葬る：07874_houmuru⟧: to give a proper burial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: politely, carefully — more neutral and everyday; focuses on politeness
- ⟦{手厚|てあつ}い→手厚い：12802_teatsui⟧: generous, cordial — the adjective form
- ⟦{厚|あつ}く→厚い：00690_atsui⟧: thickly; warmly — can also mean with warm hospitality, but more limited in usage
